> Examines the prevalence of HACK (Health-Associated Core Keystone, Goel et al. 2025) 
> species across GMWI2 quartiles (Q1–Q4). Statistical comparison focuses on Q1 vs Q4  
> using Fisher's exact test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(tibble)
library(here)

run_name   <- params$run_name
output_dir <- params$output_dir
prefix     <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data}
# Metadata with GMWI2 scores
metadata <- read_excel(here("data", "metadata.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata")
colnames(metadata) <- trimws(colnames(metadata))

# Species abundance at species level
species_abun <- read_excel(here("data", "taxa_pathway_abundance.xlsx"),
                            sheet = "abundance")

# HACK taxa reference list (Goel et al. 2025)
hacklist <- read_excel(here("data", "hack_taxa_list.xlsx"))

cat("Metadata samples:", nrow(metadata), "\n")
cat("Species in abundance file:", nrow(species_abun), "\n")
cat("HACK taxa:", nrow(hacklist), "\n")
```

## 2. Assign GMWI2 Quartiles

```{r quartiles}
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(GMWI2_Quartile = cut(GMWI2,
                               breaks        = quantile(GMWI2, probs = 0:4/4,
                                                         na.rm = TRUE),
                               labels        = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
                               include.lowest = TRUE))

quartile_summary <- metadata %>%
  group_by(GMWI2_Quartile) %>%
  summarise(N        = n(),
            GMWI2_min = min(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
            GMWI2_max = max(GMWI2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups  = "drop")

kable(quartile_summary, digits = 4,
      caption = "GMWI2 Quartile Distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 3. Calculate Prevalence by Quartile

```{r prevalence}
merged <- species_abun %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(SampleID, GMWI2, GMWI2_Quartile),
            by = "SampleID")

species_cols <- colnames(species_abun)[colnames(species_abun) != "SampleID"]

# Prevalence per species per quartile
calc_prevalence <- function(species_name, data, cols) {
  col <- cols[grepl(gsub(" ", "_", species_name), cols, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(col) == 0) return(NULL)

  data %>%
    group_by(GMWI2_Quartile) %>%
    summarise(
      Total      = n(),
      Present    = sum(.data[[col[1]]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Prevalence = Present / Total * 100,
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Species = species_name) %>%
    select(Species, GMWI2_Quartile, Prevalence, Present, Total)
}

prev_list <- lapply(hacklist$Species, calc_prevalence,
                    data = merged, cols = species_cols)
prev_data <- bind_rows(prev_list)

prev_wide <- prev_data %>%
  select(Species, GMWI2_Quartile, Prevalence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = GMWI2_Quartile, values_from = Prevalence)

kable(prev_wide, digits = 1,
      caption = "Prevalence (%) of HACK Species by GMWI2 Quartile") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## 4. Fisher's Exact Test — Q1 vs Q4

```{r fisher-test}
fisher_test <- function(species_name, data, cols) {
  col <- cols[grepl(gsub(" ", "_", species_name), cols, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(col) == 0) return(NULL)

  q1 <- data %>% filter(GMWI2_Quartile == "Q1")
  q4 <- data %>% filter(GMWI2_Quartile == "Q4")

  q1_pos <- sum(q1[[col[1]]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  q4_pos <- sum(q4[[col[1]]] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ct     <- matrix(c(q1_pos, nrow(q1) - q1_pos,
                     q4_pos, nrow(q4) - q4_pos),
                   nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ft <- fisher.test(ct)

  data.frame(
    Species       = species_name,
    Q1_Prevalence = q1_pos / nrow(q1) * 100,
    Q1_Count      = paste0(q1_pos, "/", nrow(q1)),
    Q4_Prevalence = q4_pos / nrow(q4) * 100,
    Q4_Count      = paste0(q4_pos, "/", nrow(q4)),
    Difference    = q4_pos / nrow(q4) * 100 - q1_pos / nrow(q1) * 100,
    Odds_Ratio    = ft$estimate,
    P_value       = ft$p.value
  )
}

stats_df <- bind_rows(lapply(hacklist$Species, fisher_test,
                              data = merged, cols = species_cols)) %>%
  mutate(FDR          = p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"),
         Significance = case_when(FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                   FDR < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                   FDR < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                   TRUE        ~ "ns")) %>%
  arrange(P_value)

cat("Significant HACK taxa (FDR < 0.05):", sum(stats_df$FDR < 0.05), "\n")
kable(stats_df, digits = 4,
      caption = "Fisher's Exact Test: Q1 vs Q4") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  row_spec(which(stats_df$FDR < 0.05), bold = TRUE, background = "#ffffcc")
```

## 5. Visualizations

```{r heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
hm_data <- prev_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("Species") %>%
  as.matrix()

png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "HACK_prevalence_heatmap.png")),
    width = 3000, height = 2500, res = 300)
pheatmap(hm_data,
         cluster_rows   = FALSE,
         cluster_cols   = FALSE,
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format  = "%.1f",
         number_color = "black",
         color          = colorRampPalette(c("#d92727", "#f2e288", "#006400"))(100),
         breaks         = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
         main           = "Prevalence (%) of 17 HACK Species across GMWI2 Quartiles",
	 angle_col = 0,
         fontsize        = 11,
         cellwidth       = 80,
         cellheight      = 25,
         border_color    = "white")
dev.off()
```

```{r barplot-q1q4, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
bar_data <- stats_df %>%
  select(Species, Q1_Prevalence, Q4_Prevalence, P_value, FDR, Significance) %>%
  arrange(desc(P_value)) %>%  # Sort by p-value (smallest at bottom = top in plot)
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = Species)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Q1_Prevalence, Q4_Prevalence),
               names_to = "Group", values_to = "Prevalence") %>%
  mutate(Group = recode(Group,
                        Q1_Prevalence = "Q1",
                        Q4_Prevalence = "Q4"))

p_bar <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = Prevalence, y = Species, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
           width = 0.65, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q1"  = "#5DADE2",
                               "Q4" = "#EC7063")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), limits = c(0, 115)) +
  labs(title    = "Prevalence of 17 HACK Species in Q1 vs Q4",
       subtitle = "Sorted by P-value: most significant on top",
       x = "Prevalence (%)", y = "Species", fill = "GMWI2 Group") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = c(0.93, 0.1),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), limits = c(0, 110))

# Add significance markers
sig_unique <- stats_df %>%
  filter(P_value < 0.05) %>%
  select(Species, Significance)

p_bar_sig <- p_bar +
  geom_text(data = sig_unique,
            aes(x = -2, y = Species, label = Significance),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
	    color = "red", fontface = "bold", size = 4)

print(p_bar_sig)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "HACK_Q1_vs_Q4_barplot.png")),
       p_bar_sig, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 6. Export

```{r export}
write_xlsx(list(
  Prevalence_by_Quartile = prev_wide,
  Q1_vs_Q4_Statistics    = stats_df,
  Sample_Quartile_Assign = metadata %>% select(SampleID, GMWI2, GMWI2_Quartile)
), file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "HACK_prevalence_results.xlsx")))

cat("Results exported.\n")
```
